description: H.K.G.C. Mallilka Kumarihamy and Others v. Divisional Secretary of Kundasale and Others H.K.G.C. Mallilka Kumarihamy and Others v. Divisional Secretary of Kundasale and Others View More before Hon. S. Sriskandarajah, (P/CA) J.
parties: H.K.G.C. Mallilka Kumarihamy and Others v. Divisional Secretary of Kundasale and Others H.K.G.C. Mallilka Kumarihamy and Others v. Divisional Secretary of Kundasale and Others View More
keywords: The Petitioners challenged the Respondent’s decision to charge for the allocation of the State lands in terms of a certain 1995 valuation report, contending that the land kachcheri along with a valuation was held in 1993. Held - Valuation carried out in 1993 was for a different purpose. Application dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
